main_text.p: niæ; à quo tempore Insulæ Canariæ imperii Hispanici pars fuerunt.
main_text.head: CONGENSIS.3. Con-gensis.
main_text.p: Cùm singulæ provinciæ singulos haberent Reges, tandem universæ in unius regis Bembæ[?] potestatem concesserunt: quod diu ante A. C. 1400 factum fuisse constat.
Nimirum Angola, Loango, Chiz-zama, Matama & Anzica.

page.notes: The right-margin notes are stacked and hyphenated across lines; "Potentiâ au-ctio." and "Ex-actio." are read from separate fragments and may be incomplete. Words marked [?] are uncertain: "Bembæ" in italics and "fuérc" (the printed form of the canon's last word is unclear). The left strip shows the neighbouring page's text and is excluded.
